title: ai-use: adapt to ai-accounts' T53 interface (accounts by id)
prior_work: Found work (question-explorer's job, 4 Nov): ai-accounts' T53 rewrite changed its interface without a provider notice. It removed accountReferenceSet/accountReferenceState, groupKeySet/groupKeyState/groupKeySwitches, projectKeySet, subscriptionTokenHold and projectSigninSet; accountUsesOf (ai-accounts R17) now takes {account_id}; accountFor answers differently. ai-use's suite is red on tranche (w.a.accountReferenceSet is not a function, about 80 failures), and src/ai-use/index.mjs:540 (the exploreAllowed path) still passes {owner}, so every member's account reads unreadable and exploring is refused fail-closed. Adapt this module's code and its test world to the current ai-accounts API (read build/requirements/ai-accounts.md and bio-plane/src/ai-accounts/), restating any ai-use requirement whose mechanism must change to read the account by account_id (keep its purpose), with a test that a member's explore use is read by account_id and fails with the change reverted. Any unmet mark in build/requirements/ai-use.md is yours too. Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: R10 and R13 cannot be met in ai-use's own paths. R10: its entry fallback is agent-model.estimate's range, and agent-model R34 (estimate) is still not yet met on tranche (agent-model/src has no estimate export); ai-use already answers not_known there as its Suggestions note says. Owner: agent-model (R34). R13: the requirement is met when the design stream's words.json holds the new keys ai.refused.limit.provider, ai.refused.limit.provider.unknown, ai.refused.thresholdinvalid, ai.alert.threshold, ai.use.notmeasurable (and R27's ai.refused.notapayingaccount); none is in docs/development/ux-substrate/screens/words.json on tranche (cb2e54a7). They are written once at their use in bio-plane/src/ai-use/checks.mjs (localize); adding them to the stream's sources is new wording, which is Bob's design stream, not a job's. Owner: the design stream (Bob). Nothing changed on job/ai-use. Restart this job once agent-model R34 merges and words.json holds the keys.
